newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian foreign minister: Washington's summit will not change Israeli prime minister's positions.
- United Arab Emirates strengthens its oil refining position, raises its capacity to 620,000 barrels per day.
- United Arab Emirates oil company ADNOC awards Technip contracts to develop gas project.
- Turkey seeks repayment of Libyan debts before Prime Minister Arbakan visits Tripoli.
- Twenty three Arab and foreign countries to discuss tourism strategy at a seminar in Cairo on Monday.
- Eight Arab countries meet in Cairo to coordinate their customs duty with Europe.
